findings.body: The reset test checks invite-code rows but does not open the old and new links through the public invite endpoint. The changed OpenAPI contract still lists that endpoint as returning 501, so this user-facing check belongs to the later join task.
findings.title: Later: join task should test reset links through the public invite flow
